The earlier schedule holds, and I re-derived it independently. The shared note about Cara, Ben and Ann can't be right: Ben in slot 4 would need Finn, Gus, Hana and Ivo all before slot 4, which is only three slots.

**Why this is the only schedule:**
- Ann must come right after Ben, Cara must come after Ann, and Elif must come right after Cara. So the block is Ben, Ann, Cara, Elif in consecutive slots, and "exactly one person between Ann and Elif" is Cara.
- Dev must come after Elif, so Ben can be at most slot 6. Finn, Gus, Hana and Ivo all come before Ben, so Ben is at least slot 5.
- Ben at 6 would push Elif to 9 and leave Dev nowhere, so Ben is 5. That fixes Ann 6, Cara 7, Elif 8, Dev 9.
- Gus is in slots 1–4 and must be at least three from Finn, and Ivo is before Gus. That forces Gus 4 and Finn 1. Hana right after Ivo then gives Ivo 2, Hana 3.

**Check against all 17 constraints:** Finn 1 < Ben 5; Elif 8 < Dev 9; Ann 6 right after Ben 5; Ivo 2 < Gus 4; Finn 1 < Ann 6; |Cara 7 − Gus 4| = 3; Hana 3 < Ben 5; Elif 8 right after Cara 7; Gus 4 < Ben 5; |Elif 8 − Ivo 2| = 6; Hana 3 right after Ivo 2; |Finn 1 − Gus 4| = 3; Finn 1 < Hana 3; one person (Cara) between Ann 6 and Elif 8; |Dev 9 − Finn 1| = 8; Ann 6 < Cara 7; |Ann 6 − Hana 3| = 3. All hold.

CONFIDENCE: 98
